messages:
Zoe: quick a11y note from usability session: the rollout modal (Create rollout) is causing weird SR behavior and keyboard trap issues. Repro: open modal, hit tab to cycle fields, then press ESC to close NVDA sometimes keeps reading background content after close and focus doesn't always return to the rollout button. Arman: thanks. which browser/sr combo? any console logs? Zoe: repro on Windows + NVDA (Chrome) and mac + VO (Safari). No JS errors. Steps: click "Start rollout" -> modal opens -> tab through name input -> toggle "gradual" -> press ESC -> modal closes visually but SR still reads the last focussed form label and focus lands on body. Priya: likely missing proper aria-modal/aria-hidden handling or focus return timing. Share the modal markup? Zoe: gist below: ```

Create rollout

``` When we open, we append modal-root into body and call focus on first input. We do not set aria-hidden on the app root. Dev: yep that matches classic issue. SRs will still read background content unless non-modal content is hidden/inert or aria-hidden=true. Also ensure `aria-modal="true"` is present and that focus is trapped. Arman: we also need to make sure we restore focus to the trigger element after close and delay removing the modal from DOM until after focus restore and any live region updates. Priya: proposed fixes: Move modal container to body (already done) and add `aria-modal="true"`. Set `aria-hidden="true"` on the app root (or use inert attribute/polyfill) while modal is open. Implement a robust focus trap (tab wrap) and ensure `Escape` handler closes modal and calls `triggerButton.focus()` before removing modal nodes. Use a short timeout or microtask when removing nodes to avoid SR read-after-remove race. For success toasts use a separate live region outside the modal DOM; avoid putting live updates inside focused elements. Add `role="document"` inside dialog when you have rich content so SR treats inner content correctly. Dev: I want to add one nuance: don't rely on CSS visibility to hide app content alone; screen readers still expose nodes unless aria-hidden/inert is used. If using aria-hidden, ensure IDs referenced by aria-describedby/labelledby aren't hidden incorrectly. Sam: another nit: checkbox controls inside modal need accessible name via label or aria-labelledby; and the focus style should be consistent with focus-visible tokens (outline + offset). We had a bug where focus ring was clipped by overflow hidden on .backdrop container. Zoe: good catch. overlay had `overflow: auto` and inner card had `overflow: hidden` which clipped the focus ring. Priya: CSS fixes: ensure focus-visible outline isn't clipped; set `outline-offset` and avoid `overflow: hidden` on ancestor that would clip. For mobile, ensure tap targets >= 44px; modal buttons are currently 32px. Arman: testing plan: unit test: modal opens -> assert app root has aria-hidden=true and modal has aria-modal=true. e2e: open modal -> tab through -> press ESC -> assert focus returned to trigger and SR not reading background. Run with Playwright + NVDA automation where possible. manual: VO + NVDA sweep to confirm no background reads and focus restore. Dev: i'll prepare a small PR that implements aria-hidden toggle, aria-modal attr, focus return helper, and addresses clipped focus styles. Will include CSS and a comment referencing the inert polyfill if we add it later. Sam: please also add a regression test that simulates a quick open/close (fast user) so we don't regress on timing races. Priya: add a short note to component docs: "dialog accessibility: use aria-modal, hide background with aria-hidden/inert, trap focus, restore on close, keep live regions outside modal subtree". a11y-bot: created card "Modal: focus trap + aria-hidden to prevent SR bleed" in board `a11y-regressions` and linked PR draft #1732. Zoe: thanks everyone. i'll validate once PR merges (mac+VO then windows+NVDA) and report back with quick checklist. Arman: nice catch small fix huge impact. :thumbsup:
